name: Carlos Vives
bio:
Carlos Vives discovered his passion for motorsport finance while assisting his uncle, a small team owner in the Colombian national rally series. He quickly realized his aptitude for balancing budgets and maximizing resources in the high-stakes world of racing. His career began with an internship at a karting academy, followed by a stint at a touring car team, where he honed his skills in cost analysis and financial planning.

Carlos is known for his meticulous approach to financial management and his ability to identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising performance. He is dedicated to creating transparent and sustainable financial strategies that empower teams to achieve their goals. His ability to adapt to changing circumstances and think creatively makes him a valuable asset in the ever-evolving world of motorsport.

What sets Carlos apart is his deep understanding of the human element in finance. He believes that financial stability comes from a culture of trust and open communication, working closely with team members to foster a shared commitment to financial responsibility and strategic investment.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Carlos has a focused expression and an athletic build.

quirks: Always has a detailed spreadsheet printed out, even when working on a computer.
Can calculate complex financial projections in his head faster than most people can with a calculator.
Has a lucky abacus that he keeps on his desk and occasionally clicks when pondering tough financial decisions.
